item.title: Sabrina Carpenter Gets Restraining Order Against Alleged Stalker: ‘Disturbing Violations’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show, where we bring you the latest updates on trending news. Today, we're talking about pop star Sabrina Carpenter, who's been granted a restraining order against an alleged stalker.
[Soft music continues in the background]
Host: "According to reports, 31-year-old William Applegate has been surveilling Carpenter's Los Angeles home for a month, and even attempted to break in on May 23rd. The incident was captured on Ring camera footage, which showed Applegate trying to push his way into her home.
[Pause for emphasis]
Host: "Carpenter filed a petition for a restraining order, claiming that Applegate's behavior has caused her significant fear for her personal safety and the safety of those living in her home. The court has granted a temporary order, requiring Applegate to stay at least 100 yards away from Carpenter and her home until a full hearing on June 17th.
[Soft music continues]
Host: "The LAPD detective involved in the case has stated that Applegate's conduct suggests a 'disturbing and irrational fixation' on Carpenter. The Los Angeles City Attorney's Office is also reviewing the case for possible criminal charges.
[Wrap-up music starts playing]
Host: "That's the latest on Sabrina Carpenter's case. We'll keep you updated on any further developments. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode."
[Outro music plays]
